task_name: Key/status allocation and final status NOT NULL

concerns_addressed: The correction commit changes only the human card-create lock acquisition and adds the requested cross-task race scenario; it does not alter T4 allocation, WIP, activity, signable, or statusId-rejection contracts.
The human POST now locks the workspace row before the column row and before allocateCardIdentity, matching the workspace-first order used by is_done remapping (server/src/routes/cards.ts:265-308).

The new regression uses real Supertest HTTP requests and the real PostgreSQL pool, races POST /cards against PATCH /columns/:id with isDone, and asserts committed column, card identity/status, version, uniqueness, and activity state (server/src/routes/columns-is-done-remap.failure.test.ts:71-133).
The complete remap integration entrypoint still imports all existing basic, edge, and failure scenarios; the composed suite passed all 12 tests.

strengths: The lock order is unified as workspace -> columns -> allocator: POST explicitly locks workspaces, then its target column, and allocateCardIdentity performs the counter update while the workspace lock is already held (server/src/routes/cards.ts:265-308; server/src/core/allocate-card-identity.ts:17-32).

The correction preserves the existing human transaction boundary, WIP check, identity allocation, insert fields, activity recording, publish event, hydration, and signable-assignee behavior; no production file besides cards.ts is changed.

The remap path remains workspace-first and continues to update columns/cards, record activity, and publish only after its transaction succeeds (server/src/routes/column-is-done-remap.ts:55-78; server/src/routes/columns.ts:268-289).

The race test has no sleeps, retries, or lock-order workaround. It asserts both HTTP success, the single done column, committed key/status/version/deleted state, unique key count, and the create activity event.

The correction commit contains exactly server/src/routes/cards.ts and server/src/routes/columns-is-done-remap.failure.test.ts; log.json and unrelated files are absent. Integration tests, root lint, and typecheck pass.

issues.description: The added integration test block has inconsistent indentation/formatting and npx biome check reports that the file would be reformatted. This is non-blocking because the project lint, typecheck, and composed integration suite pass.
